pages.text: “A surge of purple energy, rich in aroma, building up power for an explosive burst.”$(br2)Perilla Tea is a highly potent and explosive beverage made from dried perilla flowers and sugar. The tea has a deep purple hue and a slightly spicy taste. Drinking it provides a short but intense Strength boost, greatly enhancing the traveler’s attack power for a brief period.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Perilla Tea, $(br)boil dried perilla flowers with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed before battle, offering a massive attack boost for a short duration, making it difficult for enemies to withstand the onslaught.

Upon drinking Perilla Tea, travelers gain a short but powerful Strength boost, significantly increasing attack damage.$(br)This tea is ideal for high-intensity combat, perfect for facing formidable foes.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
